name: obs-policy-deny
question: Does an OBS bucket in ${region} whose bucket policy denies ${action} to everyone refuse ${action}, also to the account that owns it?
about: A bucket named after the project (the lease rule: <code>-...), a bucket policy that denies one listed action to every principal, then that action with the lab key. The expected answer is HTTP 403. Every step is to confirm live: see the note of the first step.

action.help: the action the policy denies; read actions only, so the probe never creates an object (GetObject asks for an object that is not there: 403 when denied, 404 when not)

steps.says: a bucket named after the project and the expiry
steps.name: ${name}
steps.confirm: the create: the call op of the key service signs obs the OBS way (awb/obs.py, B-003) and sends PUT to https://BUCKET.obs.REGION.otc.t-systems.com/ without a body, so the bucket lands in the default region; a region other than eu-de may need the location in XML. The first live run (2026-10-12, signed the gateway way) stopped here with HTTP 400 InvalidArgument. The find HEAD /BUCKET answers 200 when it is there, 404 when not

steps.says: deny the action to every principal
steps.confirm: PUT /BUCKET?policy with the policy as JSON and the OBS form of Principal and Action

steps.says: the denied action with the lab key
steps.confirm: the probe call of the action and its 403

checks.says: the bucket refuses the denied action

bucket.confirm: DELETE /BUCKET of an empty bucket; the policy goes with the bucket

kb.statement: An OBS bucket policy that denies ${action} to every principal also refuses ${action} to the account that owns the bucket, with HTTP 403, in ${region}.
